pack.name: linux-lab
pack.description: Linux endpoint conditions: process relationships, persistence, authentication, network, integrity and coverage gaps (synthetic telemetry).

scenarios.title: Shell started by a web server
scenarios.description: nginx is the direct parent of a bash process owned by the web user.
scenarios.objective: HPRC-001 detects a shell under a network-facing service.

cleanup.description: Synthetic dataset: nothing is created on any host.

limitations: Synthetic telemetry shaped like the Linux collector's output; it shows the rule's logic, not how a real host behaves.
Process names are matched exactly; a renamed server binary is not recognised.
